name: IFBench
intro: IFBench 评估语言模型对未见、可程序验证的输出约束的泛化能力。测试集包含 58 个域外约束及其 Python 验证器，构成 300 个单轮提示和 1,387 个多轮改写对话；提示来自发布时未见的 WildChat 任务，并经人工兼容性检查。论文另设 29 个 IFTrain 训练约束用于可验证奖励训练，与测试约束严格分离。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
build_method: 人工设计未见约束、实现 Python 验证器、匹配留出 WildChat 任务并人工复核
eval_feature: 域外约束、程序验证、零温度生成
scale: 58 个测试约束；300 个单轮提示；1,387 个多轮对话
build_method_en: Manual unseen constraints, executable Python verifiers, held-out WildChat task matching, and human compatibility review
eval_feature_en: Out-of-domain constraints, programmatic verification, and temperature-zero generation
intro_en: IFBench evaluates whether language models generalize to unseen, programmatically verifiable output constraints. Its test suite provides 58 out-of-domain constraints with Python verifiers, instantiated as 300 single-turn prompts and 1,387 multi-turn rewrite conversations. Tasks are sampled from WildChat prompts unseen at release time and manually checked for compatibility. The paper separately defines 29 IFTrain constraints for verifier-reward training, keeping them distinct from the test constraints.
scale_en: 58 test constraints; 300 single-turn prompts; 1,387 multi-turn conversations

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.02833 and the official allenai/IFBench release. The 58 challenging out-of-domain test constraints are manually authored from LM-user feedback and coverage analysis, grouped into count, ratio, words, sentence, format, custom, and copy categories, and paired with executable Python verifiers. Held-out WildChat tasks are manually checked for task-constraint compatibility and conflicts. The official single-turn set has 300 prompts: 256 carry one constraint and 44 carry two. The official IFBench multi-turn configuration has exactly 1,387 conversations in the form user task → assistant response → user constraint-based rewrite request. Evaluation uses temperature 0 and checks raw outputs strictly; the loose mode also strips the first or last line and selected font modifiers. Paper reporting centers on prompt-level loose accuracy. IFTrain's 29 training constraints and the optional IF-RLVR GRPO/DPO training branch are shown separately because they are not part of the 58-constraint test construction.
